author: Slidebean
description:
The open source map tracking global conflicts


A music streaming founder just built a powerful tool to track global conflicts.

It’s called World Monitor.

It combines:
• aircraft transponders
• satellite imagery
• open source intelligence feeds

All into one real time map.

Unlike most intelligence platforms, it’s fully open source, anyone can verify the data or inspect the code.

A tool built to cut through the noise.

👉 Would you trust open source tools to track global events?
title: The startup founder who built an open source war tracker
